nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Give me the heels!
Paige reluctantly hands over the box of heels. Monte quickly inspects the heels inside, confirming that they're the classy ones Paige stole from the store.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ha! I love it when justice is served!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I could have just bought them. You don't actually know that I took them, so...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You didn't buy them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Look, since you're missing proof that I took them, can I just go now?
Monte grins wide at mention of the word 'proof'.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?
The first day of school, in Ms. Lee's office.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You were caught, Paige. On the store's camera. Shoplifting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not gonna do it again! I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, that's hard to believe considering this is `the second time it's happened!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's hard to believe considering this is [color=#3b78e2][i]the second time it's happened![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: What am I going to do with you? According to the district, I'm supposed to suspend you for half the year.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Suspend me?! Please please `please` don't do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Suspend me?! Please please [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Then what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There must be some other way! Some kind of detention you can give me! I'll do anything!
Paige sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm getting tired of this... What?
Without a moment's hesitation, Paige dives into a photo booth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ack! Intruder alert!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `What` are you doing?! We're trying to take a picture!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What[/i][/color] are you doing?! We're trying to take a picture!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shh! The cops are after me! Just... Make it a group photo session!
A monitor on the wall counts down to zero, and a buzzer goes off. Paige squeezes in between them and smiles!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better not be smiling in that picture, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I really hope I wasn't...
Afterward, Paige slips out of the photo booth, and heads into the skate shop.
A moment later, she leaves, and a hand grabs her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha! Consider yourself caught!
Paige splashes into the water, noticing the brackish, dark green color!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Gross!
She rushes to the other side, hiding behind the dolphin just in time!
Unfortunately, she attracts the attention of the other mall-goers, who point and clap at her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No!
She waves her hands at them to try to get them to ignore her, but it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come on out of there, you disgraceful hooligan!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes, sir.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Consider yourself caught!
She hesitates, leaving her barely enough time to hide in the fountain!
They chase after her!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Monte's got all the exits covered... I need a place where I can hide!
She turns a corner ahead of the guards, giving her only a few seconds to find a hiding place!
Ahead of her is a photo booth and a fountain with a dolphin in the center! She hides in the...
Monte snatches her jacket collar with his hand!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no!
Paige wiggles out of her jacket!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That jacket was designer! You'd better appreciate it!
She slides down the metal divider of the escalators, landing just ahead of the other officers!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! That's mine! Er... Randy's!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bill me!
She spins back, running toward Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come to turn yourself in, eh? It's about time!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, I had a different plan in mind!
She rips open the bag, spilling the gummy pigs at Monte's feet!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That was your plan?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought they might make the floor sticky!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You thought wrong!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! That's mine! Er... Randy's!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Bill me!
She spins back, running toward Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Come to turn yourself in, eh? It's about time!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, I had a different plan in mind!
She rips open the bag, sending jawbreakers dancing across the floor like marbles beneath Monte's feet!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Whoop!
Monte's feet give out from under him and he comes crashing down to the floor just as Paige whips by!
She slides down the metal divider of the escalators, landing just ahead of the other officers!
She hesitates for just a second, paralyzed by the decision!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess I'll grab the gummy pigs...
She grabs them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This top floor is `way` nicer!
nodes.text_bbcode: This top floor is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] nicer!

nodes.text: Monte charges up behind her!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fancy Feet! You're not getting away up there! The only way down is through me!
Paige sees other security guards standing post at the stairs and the escalators down...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Think! Think! Think!
In the center of the mall is a candy kiosk. Paige rushes over!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: 'Sup. Welcome to Randy's Candy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How much for one of those big bags?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uh... Well, here at, uh, Randy's Candy, we boast, uh, hold on--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Too long!
Paige reaches across the counter and snatches up a humongous bag of...
She leaps `over` the tray!
nodes.text_bbcode: She leaps [b]over[/b] the tray!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha!
Monte snatches her jacket collar with his hand!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no!
Paige wiggles out of her jacket!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That jacket was designer! You'd better appreciate it!
She runs to the escalators and scrambles up!
Without losing a step, she leaps onto the tray and slides through the food court, giggling with joy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee hee hee! Okay, this is fun!
She dismounts at the escalators and scrambles up!
She freezes up, stopping her momentum!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha!
Monte snatches her jacket collar with his hand!

nodes.speaker: Paige

Paige wiggles out of her jacket!

nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That jacket was designer! You'd better appreciate it!
She runs to the escalators and scrambles up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm, like, your biggest fan! Er, I go to school with you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your `name,` Crazy?
nodes.text_bbcode: Your [color=#3b78e2][i]name,[/i][/color] Crazy?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Heh. Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, what's up?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't even know where to begin...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe I can help?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Doubtful. Not unless you can turn me into someone different and new and, like, `way` tougher.
nodes.text_bbcode: Doubtful. Not unless you can turn me into someone different and new and, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] tougher.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?
The next week...
Paige and Kimi are walking through the mall together...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I could get used to this!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm glad you're liking your new look! You're, like, a total rebel!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know, right?!
A group of tough kids hanging out in front of a skate shop start snickering at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You got a problem?!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, we do, actually.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What is it?!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're `not` one of us. You're just a prissy brat trying out a new `look.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] one of us. You're just a prissy brat trying out a new [color=#3b78e2][i]look.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, you can't just dress like us and call yourself a rebel.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You have to actually `act` like one.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to actually [color=#e23b3b][i]act[/i][/color] like one.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not just posing. I'm capable of doing rebel stuff.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It's not just about being capable. It's about actually wanting to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... `Want` to.
nodes.text_bbcode: I... [color=#3b78e2][i]Want[/i][/color] to.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Prove it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?
Paige is running through the mall, holding a box containing `the` perfect heels from the week before... A police officer is right on her tail!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is running through the mall, holding a box containing [b]the[/b] perfect heels from the week before... A police officer is right on her tail!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You! Stop running! You're only making this worse for yourself, Bonnie Burgles!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh! Ohmygosh!
Paige rounds a corner and bursts through a food court!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Out of the way!
She runs right into a young man, sending his food flying!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oof!
She ricochets off his stomach, his now empty food tray landing perfectly in front of her. Still running, she jumps...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just then, Kimi steps into the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa! Paige?! Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I'm obviously not okay!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But that did make me feel better...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's good. I know you're probably still reeling from that break up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who are you again?
She winds up and hurls the shoebox into the wall!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Yahhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yahhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The box crumples and the floppy heels fly out!
Just then, Kimi steps into the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whoa! Paige?! Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I'm obviously not okay!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But that did make me feel better...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's good. I know you're probably still reeling from that break up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who are you again?
...She does nothing!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's the point of getting angry?
Just then, Kimi steps into the restroom...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hey, Paige--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: --Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you think?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I... Think you could use a good punching bag after what Owen did... Just not me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do I know you?
Owen storms over to their table!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know what you're trying to pull, but it's one of the lowest things you've ever done!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What is going on? Why is the weakling here and yelling at you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Butt out, Scumbag.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How dare you speak to my date like that!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your date? How about your flimsy attempt at trying to make me jealous?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't help it if you came to the same restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You mean the same restaurant I've been coming to every Friday `all` summer!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean the same restaurant I've been coming to every Friday [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] summer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you want anyway?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I want you to grow up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well... You don't have to worry about me anymore.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're totally, absolutely, completely right.
Owen nods at Cromwell.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How's the jaw?
Then he turns and storms out of the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well... That was quite the coincidence, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: No, it was not a coincidence! You made a fool of me! Again!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You used me to get him jealous!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I didn't.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, `maybe` that's kind of exactly what I did...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]maybe[/i][/color] that's kind of exactly what I did...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: In my family, we have a saying. Fool me once, shame on you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Fool me twice, shame on how unsatisfying revenge can feel!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's a sinister family saying!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It means that I'm leaving you now, but that this isn't goodbye.
And with that, Cromwell storms out too, leaving Paige in the restaurant alone, the football guys staring at her wide-eyed from behind the potted plant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you looking at?!
They stop staring and return to their seats...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe I should have asked them `who` they were looking at...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I should have asked them [color=#3b78e2][i]who[/i][/color] they were looking at...

nodes.text: A week later...
Paige is at the mall with her mother, Margot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Remind me again `why` you insist on coming with me, Mother?
nodes.text_bbcode: Remind me again [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] you insist on coming with me, Mother?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Because we're on a budget, dear. That means I can't have you racking up debt on your credit cards!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Blech. Just pretend you're my `much` older sister, okay?
nodes.text_bbcode: Blech. Just pretend you're my [color=#3b78e2][i]much[/i][/color] older sister, okay?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You've never been embarrassed to be seen with me on shopping trips before!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we've never been shopping at this 'mall' before, if that's what you can call it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Judging by the squalor, I'm liable to run into some of my classmates... So, `try` to be cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Judging by the squalor, I'm liable to run into some of my classmates... So, [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to be cool.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh, whatever.
Paige stops in her tracks, spellbound. In the display window of a high-end shoe store, is `the` perfect pair of black high heels.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige stops in her tracks, spellbound. In the display window of a high-end shoe store, is [b]the[/b] perfect pair of black high heels.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I must have them.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `This` is why I'm here, Paige dear. We can't afford these. Not anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]This[/i][/color] is why I'm here, Paige dear. We can't afford these. Not anymore.

nodes.text: Margot holds up her hand, gesturing for Paige to give her something.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You know what. Hand over your credit cards.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I'm not a child.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You're my child. I know you, Paige. You're just going to splurge on these shoes! You can't help it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah?!
Paige marches off, into a store offering bargain deals...
A moment later, Paige shakes some new heels in Margot's face. They're cheaply made... pale imitations of the shoes from the high-end store.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See! I don't care about fancy heels!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Then I... Stand corrected.
As Margot turns to do her own shopping, Paige looks at the shoes...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great. Now I can impress no one.
Her phone rings. It's a call from her friend, Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Remember to keep your minutes low.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, cool sister doesn't care about my minutes!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Yes, but concerned `mother` does!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, but concerned [color=#3b78e2][i]mother[/i][/color] does!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.
She answers, stepping out of the store, the flimsy heels in a shoebox under her arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Connie, great to hear from you! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Paige, darling. I'm about to go yachting off the coast, and I thought you could use the sun.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Everyone's going to be there, darling, everyone. Plus, all your favorite treats... Scallops. Lobster. Caviar.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: So much seafood, you'll feel like a Great White by the time you're done.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: And all old money, so nothing awks at all. Can I count you in?
Paige fixates on the small price listed on the shoebox and knows there's no way she can afford to go...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just thinking about all those people makes me tired! But I'd love to see you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why don't we, um... Why don't we catch a movie together?!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: You `can't` be serious. All those sticky floors and loud children and bags of stale popcorn.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]can't[/i][/color] be serious. All those sticky floors and loud children and bags of stale popcorn.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I'm almost laughing imagining how miserable you'd be! Ha!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, never mind then... I'll call you back... The connection's bad...
She hangs up and beelines for the restroom!
As soon as she's certain that the bathroom's empty, she...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That night? Why do you wish such a thing?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just want to hear it from your perspective...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Very well. As I recall, the loser--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: --Owen. His name's Owen.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: He arrived, wanting to `steal` you from me.
nodes.text_bbcode: He arrived, wanting to [color=#e23b3b][i]steal[/i][/color] you from me.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: He refused my reasoned warnings to leave you alone, as you so obviously desired.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: So we fought man-to-man, fist-to-fist, and I came out the victor.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh huh...
Paige checks casually to see if Cromwell's story has caught Owen's attention...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nothing so far...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then what happened?!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then I saw you running toward me, I assumed to shower me with kisses for vanquishing our common foe.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But, no. You chose him. You chose `Owen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But, no. You chose him. You chose [color=#e23b3b][i]Owen![/i][/color]

nodes.text: At mention of Owen's name, Cromwell slams his fist on the table!
Paige sees Owen in her periphery, peeking out from behind the potted plant.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Kiss you? You are serious?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I kissed you once before. I just want to remember what it's like...
Cromwell happily obliges, leaning forward to kiss Paige. She closes her eyes, bracing herself.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is worth it! This is worth it! This is worth it!
Cromwell's lips touch Paige's, and she does everything she can to imagine she's kissing anyone but him...
Unfortunately, his breath, a sea-filled musk of escargot and anchovies, extinguishes any chance of imagination.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh!
A second later, Paige `has` to get some fresh air! She pulls her mouth away!
nodes.text_bbcode: A second later, Paige [b]has[/b] to get some fresh air! She pulls her mouth away!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Well, that was as wonderful as I remember!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, really...
She glances over at Owen, expecting him to be fuming with jealousy, but only then does she remember the potted plant blocking the view!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You've `got` to be kidding me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You've [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me!

nodes.text: Suddenly, Owen peeks his head over the top of the plant.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige?
Paige turns back to Cromwell, pretending she didn't see Owen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here it is! Time for maximum jealousy!
But Owen doesn't see them. He picks a spot in the corner of the restaurant, a potted plant blocking the view between them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, come on!
Paige rubs her stomach.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm starving!
Cromwell stares at her with disgust.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It is just five minutes to the French place! You would eat in this dump just to get your grease a hair faster?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! Sheesh!
Paige mutters under her breath.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No wonder I rejected you...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget it!
As Cromwell glares at her, Owen and the guys come in.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to know what you've been up to! Your stories are always so fascinating!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see what you have done there, changing the subject, but I don't care because I like talking about me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Heh. I know what my date likes!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Where to begin?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell

nodes.text: Promise!

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.text: Yeah, it does. You pull this crap, and you get exactly what you deserve.

Uh, I'll stay back with Paige. You guys deliver the food.

Well, that's odd. Why is she smiling?

nodes.text: Ugh. Waiting in line is so much worse than I imagined. I don't understand how you people do it?

nodes.text: `You people?` You mean, poor people?

nodes.text: Duh! I don't get why you do it! You're just, like, standing and waiting and being poor.

nodes.text: You realize you're one of us now, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. You know, a good boyfriend wouldn't remind his girlfriend of her economic status every chance he gets!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's the kind of thing that gives the 99% a bad rap.

nodes.text: That's... Er... I don't even know how to respond to that.

nodes.text: I don't know if 'awesome' is how I'd describe it--

nodes.text: Hawk is here to roost!

nodes.text: What? Are you still talking? I stopped listening after you called me hot.
